decoder_rule: Compute the original chart-local ROM votes. Keep candidates of maximum vote; among them keep candidates with the maximum number of singleton local-mask vote sources; among any remaining tie keep candidates of minimum induced degree in the chart-sharing graph.

hub_only_falsifier.structure: The six true errors induce a C6 and the three false candidates are an independent transversal inside the 9-vertex 4-regular tie graph. Pure hub-degree pruning cannot distinguish them.

provenance_repair: A false candidate can never receive a singleton-source vote: a singleton local mask decodes to the occupied coordinate itself. In the hub-only falsifier every true max-vote candidate has two singleton-source votes while every false candidate has zero.

exact_connected_weight6_scan.claim: Every connected weight-six error set through a base apartment has a nonempty refined first correction contained in the true error set. Apartment transitivity gives the same statement for every connected weight-six set.

global_component_argument: For a false candidate, each vote requires at least two errors in one of its four incident charts; those four five-coordinate neighbor blocks are disjoint, so at total error weight six a false candidate has at most three votes and zero singleton-source votes. If a disconnected error pattern has a singleton component, its true error has four singleton votes. If it has a size-two component, its true errors have at least three singleton votes. The only partition of six with neither a singleton nor a size-two component is 3+3; the exact connected weight-three census has max vote three with singleton score three in every one of the 490 rooted cases. Thus any disconnected pattern either has a true candidate with vote greater than every false candidate or has a max-vote true candidate with positive singleton score, which removes all false candidates before hub pruning. Residual weight is at most five and the refined radius-five replay clears within three sweeps.
development_replay: The exact C++ connected-weight-six scan was run over all 11,401,011 rooted sets; the weaker hub-only rule was falsified before the provenance refinement was introduced.
boundary: Finite hard-decision decoding theorem for this exact deterministic rule. It is not a maximum-likelihood theorem, a code-distance statement, or a physical noise-threshold claim. No claim is made for weight seven.
